issues.display_title: Issue #4069: Implement Photographer Profile Update Confirmation Modal
issues.main_description_html:
Brainstorming FIle: 2026-06-11-photographer-profile-update-confirmation-modal-design.md

Context

GoThru reviews every approved photographer's profile to make sure the information shown to clients is accurate and up to date. Once a photographer is approved, their profile is visible to clients and they can receive bookings.

The problem: right now, when an approved photographer edits and saves any part of their profile — whether it's their personal details, their location, their portfolio, or their equipment — the changes are submitted immediately, but the photographer gets no warning that this will temporarily remove their approved status. The profile goes back into review without the photographer knowing this was going to happen. This can be confusing and may disrupt their ability to be discovered by clients while the review is in progress.

This feature fixes that by showing a clear confirmation popup before anything is saved — so the photographer knows exactly what will happen and can choose to proceed or cancel.

Goal

Show a confirmation popup every time an approved photographer clicks Save on any of their profile pages. The popup must clearly explain that saving will temporarily put their profile back into pending review. The photographer can then choose to go ahead and save, or cancel and keep editing.

Acceptance Criteria

These are the conditions that must be true for this feature to be considered complete. Each one can be verified by opening the app and going through the steps manually — no technical knowledge required.

  1. Popup appears before saving — When an approved photographer clicks the Save button on any of these pages (Profile, Location, Portfolio, or Tools), a popup appears. Nothing is saved yet at this point.

  2. Popup shows the right content — The popup displays:

    • Title: "Profile Update Confirmation"
    • Message: "Modifying an approved profile will temporarily change your status to pending while our team reviews the new details. Please confirm to proceed with saving these updates."
    • Two buttons: "Cancel" (left) and "Save Updates" (right, highlighted as the primary action)

  3. Cancel stops everything — Clicking "Cancel", clicking the X button, or clicking outside the popup closes it without saving anything. The form stays exactly as the photographer left it — no data is lost.

  4. Save Updates submits the changes — Clicking "Save Updates" sends the photographer's changes to the server and closes the popup once the save is successful.

  5. Loading state is handled — While the save is in progress, both buttons are disabled and the "Save Updates" button shows a loading indicator. The photographer cannot close or dismiss the popup while saving is in progress.

  6. Errors keep the popup open — If the save fails for any reason (server error, network issue), the popup stays open. The photographer can try again or click Cancel to go back to the form.

  7. Status updates immediately after save — After a successful save, the photographer's status in the dashboard changes to "Pending" right away, without needing to refresh the page.

  8. Save button disappears after status change — Once the status is Pending, the Save button is no longer visible. It only reappears if the photographer is approved again.

  9. Only approved photographers see this popup — Photographers with Pending or Denied status are not affected. Their Save button behaviour remains unchanged.

  10. Works on all four save actions — The popup appears consistently when saving: Profile details, Main location, Sub-location, Portfolio, and Tools.

  11. Available in all 17 languages — The popup title, message, and button labels are fully translated in all languages the app supports.
